name: beyondwords
description: A local AI publishing house for research, writing, design, publication preparation and book-business analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Your publishing team, from idea to launch
interface.longDescription: A conversational publishing team with saved intake, evidence-backed choices, writing and cover tools, EPUB/PDF production, attended publishing, an Amazon Ads connector and restartable monitoring. Uses replaceable host AI and local helpers. Real account access and reviewed publishing/spending decisions remain required.
defaultPrompt: Help me develop my first book with Beyondwords.
Review my manuscript and prepare publication files.
Analyze my actual book royalties and advertising reports.
